decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable extension of the firm's core thermoforming range, have their own web page, and cost little to keep in the catalog.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a staple material for dental labs that complements the existing blank portfolio and supports steady consumable sales.
The UV-curing lacquer gets only a website mention, which signals lower priority, but it fits lab finishing workflows and is cheap to stock.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's strategic push into digital scanning workflows and is prominently presented.
Custom earmolds are core skilled custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, and a line with several models is likely to be refined rather than dropped.
Custom hearing protection adds an end-user and occupational segment built on the same earmold production capabilities, giving it good synergy.
